title: TopologyOverlayLayerRuntime
description: Optional runtime metadata for materialized metric/state topology overlay layers. This is execution/status metadata for an applied layer, not an agent-facing semantic planning card.

status.description: Current runtime status for this overlay layer.

catalogIds.description: Semantic catalog ids backing this materialized runtime layer.

deliveryMode.description: Materialized delivery mode for this layer.

lastUpdatedAt.description: When topology-service last evaluated or refreshed this layer.

staleAfterSeconds.description: Optional layer-local freshness hint for UI status display.

planRef.description: Opaque topology-service runtime plan reference for reconnect/resume diagnostics. Clients must not interpret it.

specHash.description: Opaque hash of the compiled runtime spec used to detect stale stream subscriptions.

message.description: Optional concise status or error message for layer details.
